message: The other day, my kids thought it would be hilarious to pretend to be fire alarms—beeping and waving their arms around. I couldn't help but laugh, but it got me thinking about how vital it is for them to know what to do in case of a real fire. So, we turned the silliness into a family escape plan practice! 🏃‍♂️ It was a fun reminder that even serious topics can be approached with a little humor. What’s your favorite way to make safety lessons engaging for the kiddos?
